summary.text: Michael F. Rivers Sr. is a Democratic member of the South Carolina House of Representatives for District 121, which covers Beaufort and Colleton Counties, serving since 2017.
His official page lists him as a minister and retired U.S. Air Force veteran.

paragraphs.text: Rivers was born on October 16, 1958, in Baltimore, Maryland.
His official page lists a technical certificate from DeVry Institute in 1980 and a B.S. from Claflin University in 2008.
He served in the U.S. Air Force from 1976 to 1978 and on the Beaufort County School Board from 1998 to 2016.
He has served in the S.C. House since 2017, and his committees are Education and Public Works and Government Efficiency and Legislative Oversight.
